expires_today.title: Love Letter to Lovecraft
expires_today.description: Our love letter to Lovecraftian gaming
expires_today.long_description:
With blood dripping from our hands, we present the Love Letter to Lovecraft Bundle. Fight to rebuild what was lost as one of the last humans living in Remnant: From the Ashes, a soulslike action-adventure rooted in Eldritch themes. Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares imaginable before you go insane in Forgive Me Father 2 Deluxe Edition, a hand-drawn Lovecraftian boomer shooter. Or maybe psychological horror is your thing—investigate the mysterious and tragic death of the Hawkins family in Call of Cthulhu. Pay what you want for thrilling experiences in gaming and help support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Humble 15th Anniversary - Ready Player One ... and Two
expires_today.long_description:
We wouldn’t be where we are today without our friends (you!!), and to celebrate that friendship as well as our 15th Anniversary, we’ve compiled a bundle of our favorite games to play solo or with a bestie. As such, the low price tier of this bundle gets you one copy of each game, and the high tier gets you two—and saves you $4! Keep the beats bumping and the beatdowns coming in street fighting beat-’em-up Streets of Rage 4! Separate your real friends from their mimics in survival horror game Mimesis! Battle against the genetically engineered zeds in Killing Floor 3! Grab these games and more for yourself and/or a buddy for the price of your choice, and help support REVERB’s green music movement with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Image in the '20s: A Megabundle by Image Comics
expires_within_72h.long_description: The decade may only be half over, but the 2020s have been good to Image Comics, one of the most exciting publishers of the day that is consistently putting out great stuff. To celebrate Image’s recent successes, we’ve put together a megabundle of their best series, so that longtime fans and new readers can find their new favorite stories! This bundle includes collected volumes of tech dystopian superhero story The Dead Lucky, rural Canadian horror series Fishflies, intergalactic warrior drama Free Agents, geriatric battle royale action series Golden Rage, child vampire saga Little Monsters, and more! If those sound good to you, just wait to see what else is in store in this giant—and we mean giant—bundle of Image’s best new comics! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Self-Reliance and Off-Grid Skills for Dummies
expires_within_72h.long_description: Don’t just survive in the modern outdoors—thrive. Get amazing titles like Solar Power Your Home For Dummies, 2e, Vegetable Gardening For Dummies, 3e, How to Fix Everything For Dummies, and Ham Radio For Dummies, 4e.
